turing_hall.name: Lecture hall
turing_hall.blurb: A big tiered lecture hall with a projector that takes three tries to turn on.

locker_hallway.name: Locker hallway
locker_hallway.blurb: A long hallway of numbered lockers, starting at 0.

ta_office.name: TA office
ta_office.blurb: A small, very tidy room with a whiteboard and a sign-up sheet.

tutoring_center.name: Tutoring center
tutoring_center.blurb: Couches, snacks, and a whiteboard covered in other people's handwriting. Monty volunteers here.

exam_hall.name: Exam hall
exam_hall.blurb: Rows of single desks and a big clock on the wall that ticks too loudly.

turing_vending.name: Vending alcove
turing_vending.blurb: A vending machine that eats every third dollar. Someone taped a sign to it that says "Known issue. Won't fix."

faculty_hallway.name: Faculty hallway
faculty_hallway.blurb: Office doors covered in old comics, and a "Back in 5 minutes" sign that has been up since 2019.

council_room.name: Student council room
council_room.blurb: Labeled folders, two coffee mugs, and a very large binder. Julian is always here early.

council_balcony.name: Council balcony
council_balcony.blurb: A stone balcony off the council room that looks over the main quad.

server_room.name: Server room
server_room.blurb: The basement. Ancient, humming servers that have run campus systems forever.

oracle_great_hall.name: Oracle Great Hall
oracle_great_hall.blurb: The formal ballroom. Chandeliers and a long guest list.

registrar.name: Registrar's office
registrar.blurb: A long line, a take-a-number machine, and a screen that says "Now serving: 404."

fortran_waiting_room.name: President Fortran's waiting room
fortran_waiting_room.blurb: Leather chairs, a ticking grandfather clock, and a framed punch card on the wall. The door to the president's office is always closed.

lovelace_library.name: Reading room
lovelace_library.blurb: Long tables, green reading lamps, and a card catalog nobody uses but Monty.

library_stacks.name: The stacks
library_stacks.blurb: Narrow aisles of shelves and a cart of returns that never gets shorter.

university_archive.name: University Archive (Sun Wing)
university_archive.blurb: Dusty records and old portraits of the Sun household, which the Oracle family later absorbed.

study_carrels.name: Quiet study carrels
study_carrels.blurb: Rows of tiny desks with walls. It's so quiet you can hear someone's laptop fan spinning up.

microfilm_room.name: Microfilm room
microfilm_room.blurb: A windowless room with two microfilm readers. One of them hums. Nobody has asked for microfilm in years.

hopper_lab.name: Hopper Computer Lab
hopper_lab.blurb: The basement. Rows of humming machines and flickering lights. Ciel practically lives here at 2 a.m.

capstone_room.name: Capstone team room
capstone_room.blurb: Third floor. A glass-walled project room with a big screen for code review.

cs_rooftop.name: Knuth Hall rooftop
cs_rooftop.blurb: Through the fire door at the top of the lab stairwell. Quiet, cold, and facing the sunrise.

cs_lounge.name: Department lounge
cs_lounge.blurb: A worn couch, an espresso machine with a handwritten user manual, and a whiteboard asking "Free pizza Friday???"

computer_museum.name: Computer museum hallway
computer_museum.blurb: Glass cases of old machines: a punch card reader, a beige desktop with a floppy drive, and a modem that still makes the noise when you press the button.

lab_stairwell.name: Lab stairwell
lab_stairwell.blurb: Concrete stairs from the basement lab to the roof. Someone has been keeping a tally of all-nighters on the wall. It's a lot.

hackathon_hall.name: Hackathon hall
hackathon_hall.blurb: A big open room with power strips everywhere, pizza boxes, and LED strips.

game_dev_club_room.name: Game dev club room
game_dev_club_room.blurb: A cramped room off the main hall with old consoles and a whiteboard of engine diagrams. Not officially a club. Ciel runs it from the shadows.

union_arcade.name: Arcade
union_arcade.blurb: The union basement. Old arcade machines with strange rules and a scoreboard that adds wrong.

union_rooftop.name: Union rooftop
union_rooftop.blurb: String lights, a couple of beat-up beanbags, and the best sunset on campus. Night Jay's favorite spot ("We're going to the roof").

campus_radio.name: Campus radio booth
campus_radio.blurb: WRUN, the student radio station. A tiny booth with a red ON AIR light and lo-fi beats playing around the clock.

union_lounge.name: TV lounge
union_lounge.blurb: Big couches, a TV stuck on the weather channel, and a ping pong table with one paddle.

main_quad.name: Quad lawn
main_quad.blurb: The center of campus. Students everywhere, a frisbee always in the air.

fountain_bench.name: Fountain bench
fountain_bench.blurb: A stone bench by the quad fountain. A good place to sit and think.

picnic_lawn.name: Picnic hill
picnic_lawn.blurb: The sunny hill at the corner of the quad, up toward the library.

festival_stage.name: Festival stage
festival_stage.blurb: A temporary stage on the quad that runs on the site Jay built.

clock_tower.name: Clock tower
clock_tower.blurb: The old clock tower at the edge of the quad. It's been exactly one hour off since daylight saving time ended. Students call it the off-by-one clock.

founders_statue.name: Founders' statue
founders_statue.blurb: A bronze statue of the university's founders with a small bronze rubber duck at its base. Its beak is shiny from students rubbing it for luck before exams.

observatory.name: Observatory dome
observatory.blurb: A big old telescope under a dome that opens with a loud crank.

observatory_lobby.name: Observatory lobby
observatory_lobby.blurb: A model of the solar system hangs from the ceiling. Pluto is attached with tape and a sticky note that says "still counts".

observatory_deck.name: Viewing deck
observatory_deck.blurb: A narrow deck around the dome. On a clear night you can see the whole campus lit up below.

the_stack.name: The Stack (dining hall)
the_stack.blurb: A big, loud dining hall with a stack of trays at the door and a long lunch line.

cafe_cache.name: Café Cache
cafe_cache.blurb: The campus coffee shop, with a bubble tea counter in the back for Jay. Home of the coffee appreciation society.

bookstore.name: Campus bookstore
bookstore.blurb: Textbooks, hoodies, and a wall of laptop stickers.

the_heap.name: The Heap (convenience store)
the_heap.blurb: A tiny corner store where everything is piled in no particular order. You can always find what you need, eventually.

mail_room.name: Mail room
mail_room.blurb: A wall of package lockers and a bin of packages nobody has picked up. One of them has been here since last spring.

babbage_hall.name: Your room
babbage_hall.blurb: A bed, a desk, a laptop, and a rubber duck with opinions.

dorm_common_room.name: Common room
dorm_common_room.blurb: A shared lounge with a lumpy couch, a TV, and a bulletin board.

laundry_room.name: Laundry room
laundry_room.blurb: Four washers and a schedule on the wall that Monty scripted. It actually works.

babbage_lobby.name: Front desk
babbage_lobby.blurb: A sleepy RA, a bowl of free mints, and a bulletin board full of flyers for clubs that meet at 8 a.m.

kitchenette.name: Kitchenette
kitchenette.blurb: A shared kitchen with one working burner, a fridge full of labeled leftovers, and a note on the microwave: "PLEASE cover your food. You know who you are."

greenhouse.name: Greenhouse
greenhouse.blurb: Warm, humid, and full of labeled plant pots. The gardening club's home.

campus_garden.name: Hedge maze garden
campus_garden.blurb: Winding paths next to the greenhouse, with a small hedge maze at the center.

duck_pond.name: Duck pond
duck_pond.blurb: A small pond by the garden. Quack has opinions about the real ducks.

compost_corner.name: Compost corner
compost_corner.blurb: A row of compost bins behind the greenhouse. A hand-painted sign on them says "Garbage collection".

gazebo.name: Gazebo
gazebo.blurb: A white gazebo in the middle of the garden paths, with a bench and climbing roses. Quiet, except for the bees.

fitness_center.name: Gym
fitness_center.blurb: Weights, mirrors, and a lot of people counting reps.

running_track.name: Running track
running_track.blurb: A loop around the athletic field. Everyone is counting laps.

pool.name: Swimming pool
pool.blurb: An indoor pool that smells like chlorine. A sign at the deep end says "No diving into anything you can't get out of."

climbing_wall.name: Climbing wall
climbing_wall.blurb: A tall wall of colorful holds. Every route has a name, like "Stack Overflow" and "Infinite Loop".

bleachers.name: Bleachers
bleachers.blurb: Metal bleachers beside the running track. A good spot to sit and watch everyone else run.
